scheme_name: Scheme of Assistance for the Prevention of Alcoholism & Substance (Drugs) Abuse and for Social Defence Services: General Grant-in-Aid Programme for Financial Assistance in the Field of Social Defence
other_conditions: Eligible organizations must be a Society registered under the Indian Societies Registration Act, a charitable non‑profit company, a Public Trust, a registered non‑official organization, or institutions such as universities, research institutes, schools, Panchayati Raj Institutions, Municipal Corporations, Town Area Committees, or Red Cross Societies
The organization should have at least two years of experience in the relevant area or be able to demonstrate competence to undertake the proposed scheme
It must not be operated for profit for any individual or body of individuals
A properly constituted Managing Body with defined powers, duties and responsibilities laid down in a written constitution is required
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to 90% (or up to 100% in special cases) of the approved project cost for eligible organizations, covering construction, equipment, staff salaries and other operational expenses, with a grant ceiling of ₹10 lakh per project.
